Commentary.Commentary: The Afghan bowlers had an off day as one of their main bowlers, Mohammad Nabi gave away 48 runs in his quota of 4 overs. Amir Hamza and Rashid Khan were pick of the bowlers. The former scalped two wickets and gave away just 23 runs while the former took one wicket and affected two run outs. The quickies were expensive too. With 166 to chase, the hosts will need Shahzad to fire up top. Stay tuned for the chase!

Porterfield was looking good in the middle before he got run out. The game was set beautifully for Kevin O'Brien and Gary Wilson to launch from. However, the former was struggling out in the middle as the Afghan spinners pulled the game back in their favour. But, Wilson stayed till the very end and finished the innings on high, scoring 41 off just 27!

39 runs in the last three overs ensured that Ireland cross the 160-run mark and finish on high. They were pushed on the back foot in the first over itself as they saw the back of Paul Stirling. However, from then onwards it was all Ireland. The experiment of opening with Stuart Thompson worked wonders for them as he went on to score his maiden T20I fifty and added 82 runs for the second wicket with his skipper, William Porterfield.

OUT! Full delivery in the line of the stumps, Wilson drives it through the mid-wicket region. The players run a couple. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end and the bowler does not collect the throw. Wilson calls for a third and the fielder from the cover region has a throw at the striker's end this time. Shahzad collects it well and dislodges the bails quickly. Tucker has to walk back to the hut as the Irishmen tried to steal the third. He was way out. IRELAND END ON 165/5.
SIX! In the arc! Tossed up delivery into the stumps, Wilson slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That goes far into the stands. Powerful hitting by Wilson.
Another reverse sweep this time, the ball goes towards the fielder at point. The batsmen manage to pick up a single.
Wilson lofts it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Slow and outside off, Wilson punches it through the cover region for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Wilson goes for a big hit but is beaten by the line of the ball.
Again a short delivery into the stumps, Wilson pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Free hit delivery, pitched short in the line of the stumps, Wilson stays in his crease and mistimes his pull through mid on for a couple.
Free hit coming up...

No ball! Beamer outside off, Tucker tries to throw his bat at it but is unable to make contact. The ball hits the keeper's pads and goes towards the short fine leg region. The players call for a bye and the fielder from square leg covers some distance and throws at the non-striker's end. He hits and the umpire goes upstairs to check for a run out. Replays show that Tucker was in just in time to complete the run.
The umpire have gone upstairs for a run out appeal.
FOUR! Short delivery into the body, Tucker pulls it away powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! Super stroke! In the line of the stumps, Tucker covers his stumps and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary. Brave shot by the batsman.
Full into the stumps, Wilson blocks it right in front of the stumps and runs a quick single. Zadran tried to reach it quickly but the non-striker was really quick.
FOUR! Full toss way outside off, Wilson throws his bat to it and guides it over the point region for a boundary. Easy pickings!
Short and angling into the pads, Tucker gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flipper outside off, Wilson tucks it towards point for a single.
Outside off, spinning away. Tucker reverse sweeps it fine down the off side for a single.
Full around off, Wilson eases it through the mid on region for a single.
Full outside off, Wilson drives it through the cover region for a couple.
FOUR! Full outside off, Wilson sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary. He read the line of the ball really early and made it look easy.
Full toss outside off, Wilson drives it straight through the cover region for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Wilson guides it towards the fielder at point.
Full outside off, moves away, beats Wilson in his defence. Superb delivery that!
Outside off, played to point for a single.
Slower one! Tucker fails to pick it and goes through with his pull but misses it completely.
Full outside off, pushed in the cover region for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Leg bye! On the pads, Tucker misses his flick. The ball goes off the pads on the leg side for a leg bye.
Short delivery outside off, cut away through square on the off side for a brace.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Angling into the pads, Wilson kneels down and paddles it fine past short fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, played to point.
Driven to long on for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Lorcan Tucker is the new man in!

OUT! Huge wicket! Leg spinner outside off, O'Brien charges down the wicket. Fails to pick the leg break and also doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. Misses it completely and Shahzad behind the stumps collects the ball calmly and takes the bails off. Big wicket for Afghanistan as you know how dangerous can O'Brien be in death!
On the pads, worked on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
O'Brien gets to the pitch of the ball and goes over the covers for a brace.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Floated on middle, swept to deep mid-wicket for two.
Flatter on the pads, O'Brien fails to flick and it goes off off his pads to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Around the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Amir Hamza is called back into the attack.
Flighted ball on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Short outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Served outside off, Kevin looks to defend but gets an outside edge to point.
Served around off, turning away, O'Brien fails to pick it and is beaten in his defence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gary Wilson walks out next to the middle.

Drama in the middle! Porterfield has to walk back! Full outside off, pushed through covers. Porterfield comes back for second. The player at sweeper cover picks up the ball and hurls it to the striker's end. Hits but Porterfield is well in. The ball takes a deflection in the mid-wicket region. Seeing that, Porterfield calls for third. Rashid Khan the bowler, runs towards the ball and throws at the bowler's end. He hits too! The umpires then have check upstairs. The replays show that Porterfield didn't make it in with his full-stretched dive!
The players have gone upstairs for a run out appeal.
Slower one outside off, Kevin comes ahead but is beaten by the lack of pace.
Full around off, eased on to long off for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, WP comes forward to clip but gets squared up. Gets off the leading edge to point.
Full and angling across, keeps low as well. Porterfield is beaten in his drive. Shahzad does well behind the stumps!
FOUR! Innovation at its best! Fuller delivery on middle, Porterfield gets across and paddle scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
On a length outside off, driven on the up through covers for a single.
Karim Janat is back into the attack.

Served around middle and leg, William leans ahead and clips it through mid-wicket. Shafiqullah runs towards the ball. Goes for the one-hand pickup but misses. Gives away an extra run as the batsmen run through for a couple.

Loud shout for lbw! Around leg, straightening a bit, WP looks to defend it off the front foot but gets hit high on the pads. The ball lobs in the silly point region. There's a loud appeal for lbw but turned down. Height maybe the factor!
Short delivery, sliding away from the southpaw, Porterfield backs away and slaps through covers for a couple.
A touch shorter around off, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
FOUR! Served full around off, O'Brien backs away a touch, kneels down and goes inside out over extra cover for a boundary.
Slides it quicker on the leg pole, driven back to the bowler.
Rashid Khan is into the attack!
Floated outside off, Kevin O'Brien drives it through the cover region for a single.
Floated outside off, Porterfied punches it off the back foot for a single.
Kevin O'Brien walks in next!

OUT! Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Thompson dances down the track and lofts it over the mid-wicket region. The ball does not come off from the middle. Zadran the fielder at long on rushes towards his left to take a fine running catch. Thompson's beautiful innings comes to an end and he has to walk back to the hut. Hamza finally gets a very important breakthrough. End of a 82-run stand.
Full in the line of the stumps, Thompson lofts it over the mid off region for a couple.
Again on the pads, William clips it down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Innovation! Floated down the leg side, Porterfield gets the broom out of his bag and reverse sweeps it through the point region for a boundary.
Again outside off, Thompson cannot reach it again.
Wide outside off, Thompson tries to reach at it but the ball was too far for him.
Maiden T20I fifty for Stuart Thompson!
SIX! What a way to get to the fifty! Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Thompson stands deep in his crease and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full outside off, Thompson eases it down towards long off for a single.
Angling across again, William pushes it through the mid off region for a single.
Short delivery angling across, Porterfield dances down the track and pushes it wide of mid off for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Thompson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.

There is a halt in play as the powerful straight drive from Thompson hit Hamza on his legs. The physios are out to treat him. Meanwhile, the other players hydrate themselves as the conditions are very hot out there!

Full outside off, Thompson guides it powerfully down the ground. The bowler stretches his leg out to stop it and saves a certain boundary. The ball deflects  down the ground  and the batsmen pick up a couple.
Full into the pads, Thompson is unable to clip it off his pads.
Down the leg side, Thompson tries to clip it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads.
Full delivery again, Porterfield clips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full in the line of the stumps, Thompson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Amir Hamza is back in for a bowl.
Short and wide outside off, Thompson guides it towards the third man region for a single.
FOUR! Full and smashed! Full delivery in the line of the stumps, Thompson stays in his crease and powerfully drives it down the ground for a boundary. No fielder could stop that.
Length delivery angling into the stumps, Thompson lofts it over the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Angling into the pads, Porterfield clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Thompson guides it towards third man for a single.
50-run stand between Thompson and Porterfield!

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, the width allows Thompson to cut it elegantly through backward point for a boundary. With this, 50 runs up for Ireland as well as the 50-run stand between Thompson and his skipper, Porterfield!
Karim Janat will bowl the next over.

Short into the stumps, Porterfield makes room and punches it through covers. The cover fielder cannot stop it and the batsmen manage to pick up a couple of runs. Brilliant over for Ireland as 21 runs come off it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Again it's short, Porterfield camps back and pulls it powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! Width on offer and punished! Short delivery outside off, William stays in his crease and punches it powerfully through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Full in the line of the stumps, Thompson sweeps it towards the fielder at short fine leg. Zadran there, makes a half stop and a single it taken!

SIX! BIGGIE! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Thompson reads the line well, gets to the pitch of the ball and smacks it over the bowler's head for a maximum. First one of the match! He is taking the charge!
FOUR! Top Shot! Short delivery, Thompson waits for it and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Porterfield pulls it through the mid-wicket region. Shafiqullah covers some distance from deep square leg and dives towards his right to save the boundary. The batsmen manage to run two.

Down the leg side this time, WP dances down the track and tries to clip it over the in-field on the leg side. He is beaten by the pace and the ball hits him on the pads. Zadran gives the ball a chase and kicks it towards the striker's end.
Slinging in from a length outside off, William shuffles and punches it to mid on.
Full delivery outside off, Porterfield drives it powerfully down the ground but straight to the fielder at mid off.
Angling into the stumps from a fuller length, Thompson eases it down the ground for a quick single towards mid on.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Thompson clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Down the leg side, Stuart clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single. Good comeback by Nabi, just 4 from it!
Floated outside off, William comes down the track and drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Porterfield uppishly drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Into the pads, Thompson clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Stuart stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Porterfield drives it through the mid off region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Stuart drives it towards the cover-point region. Nabi from covers dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Thompson punches it towards the fielder at point.

FOUR! Down the leg side, ST clips it beautifully through the square leg region. The fielder from deep mid-wicket tries to cut it off with a dive but the ball wins the race. Another boundary for Thompson.
Good comeback delivery by Zadran. Good length delivery outside off, Thompson tries to cut it but he is beaten there.
FOUR! Overpitched delivery angling into the stumps, Thompson stays in his crease and drives it beautifully through the extra cover region for a boundary. Brilliant shot!
Full outside off, Stuart drives it straight towards the fielder at covers.
Shapoor Zadran is into the attack now!
Porterfield prods forward and defends the last ball of the over. Good over for Ireland, 11 runs from it!
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery spinning in from outside off, William camps back and punches it through the mid on region for a boundary. First boundary for the captain.
Spinning into the stumps, Porterfield stays in his crease and defends it well.
Full into the stumps, Stuart clips it through the mid-wicket region for a triple.
Outside off, Thompson gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
FOUR! Misfield! Tossed up outside off, Thompson drives it through covers. the fielder cannot stop it and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Spin from both ends as Mohammad Nabi will share the new ball.
Clipped with the angle to mid-wicket. What a start by Hamza! Just one run and wicket from it!
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
William Porterfield will bat at number 3!

OUT! EARLY STRIKE! Quicker through the air in the line of stumps, Stirling goes for the sweep shot. Misses and the ball goes on to hit the timber. Superb start for Afghanistan! Stirling is disappointed!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served fuller outside off, pushed to mid off for a single. First runs on board!
Flatter around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
The players are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and  Stuart Thompson will open the batting for Ireland. Amir Hamza will start the proceedings with the ball.

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Stanikzai says that the surface looks dry. Adds that he would like to restrict Ireland to 150. He is happy to come into the series with a winning momentum and see the his team full of confidence.

Ireland captain, William Porterfield says that the pitch is really a good one to bat on, so he feels that batting initially would be easier for them. Also adds that this track will be the best track of this series. States that they would look to post a total above the 160-run mark which should be a competitive total.
Toss - Ireland win the toss and elect to bat first.

Pitch Report - Chetan Sharma says that he can see some cracks on the pitch. Adds that there is a pinch of grass which would make the cracks keep intact for the initial phase. Opines that fast bowlers won't get much help from the deck as compared to the spinners. Ends by saying that it is a spinner's paradise.

Hello and a warm welcome for the first match of the 3-match T20I series between Afghanistan and Ireland. The home side have been in terrific form and will like to keep their winning momentum going as they host a long series in Greater Noida (India), which happens to be their adopted home ground. Ireland, on the other hand, will look for revenge to their 10-wicket loss against the Pashtuns in the final of the Desert T20 Challenge. Expect it to be a cracker! Stay tuned for the toss.
